text: The first direct commercial flight in years between the US and Venezuela is about to take off from Miami this morning. American is the operator. WH's National Energy Dominance Council's Jarrod Agen is onboard as is Venezuela's Ambassador to the US Felix Plascencia, two officials

text: The British government has pledged about $34 million to combat what one cabinet member is calling an antisemitism emergency facing the U.K., a day after two Jewish men were stabbed in broad daylight in north London in an incident being investigated as terrorism.
translated_text: 英国政府承诺提供约3400万美元，以应对一名内阁成员所说的英国面临的反犹太主义紧急情况，一天前，两名犹太男子在伦敦北部光天化日之下被刺伤，该事件正在被作为恐怖主义进行调查。

text: The backlash was immediate after the Trump administration served notice that hospitals and nursing homes should limit sugary drinks and dietary supplements in favor of what HHS terms "real food."
